For an internationally active advisory and professional services organization, we are looking for an Audit Manager to strengthen the team in the Brussels region.
 
 You will join a dynamic and growth-oriented environment where audit goes beyond compliance. In this role, you combine technical expertise, team leadership and client advisory, while working closely with both national and international clients. You will play an active role in developing the audit practice and supporting long-term client relationships, all within an attractive package including a company car.
 
 Audit Manager - Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate financial audit engagements for a diverse portfolio of mid-sized companies and international clients, ensuring quality, efficiency and timely delivery. 
• Manage, coach and develop an experienced audit team while acting as a technical point of reference and supporting their professional growth. 
• Act as a trusted advisor towards clients by providing insights, discussing findings and delivering tailored recommendations beyond the audit scope.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in external audit, ideally within an international or consulting environment.
• Registered Auditor qualification is considered a strong asset.
• Strong technical audit knowledge combined with leadership and coaching capabilities. 
• Fluent in French and English.

jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities

As a Trade Marketing Intern, you will assist the Trade Marketing Specialist by contributing to the implementation of the trade marketing strategy.

Strategic Marketing

• Support the development of international marketing strategies through market research, competitive analysis and benchmarking.
• Contribute to the implementation of global marketing and trade marketing initiatives across key markets.
• Prepare compelling marketing presentations for internal meetings, distributors and retail partners.
• Assist in the analysis of campaign performance and provide recommendations for future activations.
Trade Marketing

• Assist in the creation and development of sales and marketing tools (brochures, catalogs, POS materials, posters, etc.).
• Provide day-to-day marketing support to the brand's agents, distributors, and retail partners.
• Coordinate POS (Point of Sale) material orders with suppliers and oversee their distribution.
• Assist in the development and implementation of merchandising and window display concepts across the brand's stores.
• Create and distribute newsletters to the sales teams, ensuring regular communication on product launches, campaigns, and trade marketing initiatives.
• Develop trade marketing assets for department store activations and retail campaigns in collaboration with internal teams.
• Support the continuous improvement and update of Visual Merchandising guidelines to ensure brand consistency across all markets.
• Support the continuous improvement and update of Training Books to ensure brand consistency across all markets.
• Assist in the coordination and execution of trade marketing campaigns with key retail partners.
• Monitor the implementation of in-store activations and provide feedback to optimize execution.
• Liaise with internal departments (Marketing, Sales, Retail, Creative and Logistics) to ensure smooth execution of trade marketing projects.
Budget

• Assist in monitoring and tracking the marketing budget.
• Support the follow-up of marketing expenses.
• Ensure accurate budget tracking and maintain up-to-date reporting tools.
 
 
Desired Profile

• Education: Student in marketing, communication, international business, project management, or a similar field.
• Technical Skills: Proficiency in presentation tools (PowerPoint, Canva, etc.) and market analysis tools (benchmarking, insights research, competitive analysis) & Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite.
• Personal Qualities: Creative, meticulous, independent, proactive with a strong ability to manage different projects at the same time. Organisation is key. 
• Languages: Proficiency in English and French (excellent spelling and grammar). Dutch is a plus.

• Additional: A car is preferred, as the offices are located 15 km outside of Brussels. (Wavre)

Our client is an international maritime organization based in Essen.

Jobomschrijving

Unique Antwerp Maritime is looking for a Crew Planner.
You will be working for one of our clients, one of the largest offshore pipeline installation and subsea construction companies, located in Essen.

In this role, you will take full responsibility for crew planning within your assigned disciplines. You ensure everything runs smoothly — from long-term workforce planning to last-minute solutions.

Your responsibilities include:
	
• Creating and managing crew schedules for personnel on board our vessels	
• Acting as the point of contact for superintendents, captains, and shore-based colleagues	
• Collaborating closely with HR, Operations, and the crew members themselves	
• Taking into account experience, certifications, and project requirements	
• Identifying shortages or surpluses in staffing and contributing to solutions	
• Ensuring a fair distribution of experience and opportunities within teams	
• Discussing career growth and development opportunities for crew members together with HR
In short: you maintain oversight in a dynamic environment where no two days are the same.

What matters to us?
Your curiosity, drive, and enjoyment of what you do. It’s a big plus if you also bring:
	
• At least 3 to 5 years of experience in a similar role, such as crew planning or transport planning	
• The ability to stay calm and maintain an overview, even when everything happens at once	
• Clear and friendly communication skills, with a good sense of humor	
• The confidence to make decisions and take responsibility, always with respect and situational awareness	
• Fluency in spoken and written English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus	
• A willingness to travel occasionally, for example to vessels or our office in Delft

Team/division description
 

The work tasks to be developed will be held in Chassis Engineering group, in Chassis Design division. Chassis Design is responsible for the: 1) Development of Chassis parts (Brake, Steering, Suspension, Tyre, Shift, Pedals, ...) to achieve the highest driving performance and quality at the competitive price. 2) Local development of Chassis parts for vehicles built in Toyota’s European assembly plants. This activity is done in close cooperation with local suppliers and Toyota Motor Corporation in Japan. 3) Investigation of new European technologies 
 

We are inspired by the Toyota Way precepts, and we challenge to provide final customers with best quality products with the continuous improvement mindset.
 

Your responsibilities
 

The main responsibility of the open position for interim is work on the development of Brake system and components to fulfil the basic performance of chassis brakes for development, and current mass production, vehicles. The main activity will be to lead the project development with our brake systems suppliers and, in addition, monitor and research the market trends of brake components In the context of this project the successful candidate will perform the following activities:
 

 
• Support project development of chassis commodities (e.g. brake) 
 
• Support technical investigation leading to quality or cost improvements 
 
• Verification of installation requirements, technical drawings and 3D models
 
• Summarize the evaluation reports and document the processes
 
• Prepare functional safety status overview for quality and ISO audits
 
• Support field investigations, trouble diagnostics and troubleshooting
 
• Coordinate development activities with evaluation team
 
• Research and monitor technology trends for brake systems, and components 

Your profile
 

 
• You are fluent in English (Toyota Motor Europe business language). Japanese is an asset.
 
• You have a practical knowledge of CATIA design tool (drafting, assembly and 2D sketching)
 
• You have good knowledge/experience of Strength of materials and FEA
 
• Chassis systems and Vehicle Dynamics knowledge are an asset
 
• Project management skills are an asset
 
• Intermediate programming skills (Python, Matlab) are an asset
 
• You have a Bachelors in Mechatronics or Mechanical Engineering 
 
• Experience on component design is a benefit
 
• It is preferred if you have experience in a similar position in the automotive sector or in an industrial mass production environment 
 

Your key competencies are:
 

 
• Excellent communication skills (both verbal & written)
 
• Team player
 
• Pro-active and persistent
 
• Self-confident
 
• Proceed job with own initiative
 
• Analytical approach and Problem-solving
 
• At ease with Japanese culture and respectful of cultural differences

You are fully convinced that data science isn’t a hype, but you also believe that, in order to be valuable and really make a company smarter, it must be done right. Your goal is therefore to create the most impactful solution possible in the quickest and easiest way possible so that real value can be extracted from data and artificial intelligence. 

Are you brimming with fresh ideas to lead our Data Science team in providing data-driven solutions to our customers based on the latest machine learning models and deep learning algorithms? If you are looking for a new challenge with a steep learning curve, and the support of a dynamic team, you may be our next Data Scientist.

As a Data Scientist, you will dive into the world of artificial intelligence. You will apply your skills to real scenarios and in different domains, such as drug discovery in healthcare, fraud detection in banks, the development of recommendation systems in the retail sector, and more.

 

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following:

• At least 3+ years of experience in Data Science.
• Master's degree (or equivalent through experience) in a field that is highly data-driven. 
• Experience with some of the following data science techniques: supervised and unsupervised learning models, deep learning, anomaly detection, recommender systems, natural language processing, computer vision and reinforcement learning.
• Well versed in open-source software and libraries in Python and/or R for machine and deep learning.
• Extensive experience in building and implementing advanced analytics solutions backed up with some reference cases.
• Experience with big data and platforms such as Azure Machine Learning Services and Amazon SageMaker is a plus.
• Experience in one of the following languages: Python, R, Spark, Scala, Java or C++.
• You are resident in Belgium and look forward to working a few days a week at the client's office.
• 
You are fluent in Dutch or French and in English.

jobs.employer_name: BIO BASE EUROPE PILOT PLANT VZW
jobs.description:
As a Bio Process Technician at BBEPP, you choose a job that is truly different. You will work with a team of engineers and technicians on a wide variety of innovative projects. No routine work, but an inspiring environment where you gain new insights, deepen your expertise, and further develop your talents. Together with your colleagues, you scale up and optimize bio-based processes (from lab to industrial scale) that contribute to a sustainable bio-economy and to solutions for today’s and tomorrow’s climate challenges.

In the role of a Bio Process Technician, you are responsible for preparing processes and setting up (pre-) industrial pilot installations. In addition to setting up these test installations, you will also carry out the different process steps and operate the corresponding equipment. In consultation with the process engineers, you closely monitor the process parameters of the scale-up processes assigned to you (fermentation, biocatalysis, purification). You regularly take samples, analyse them in the lab, and critically evaluate the results, actively contributing ideas for potential improvements. Moreover, you act as a true ambassador for safety, structure, and hygiene in the process environment.

We're looking for a motivated weekend employee (2 x 12-hour nights per week + 2 x 8-hour days per month). You're a hands-on technician with a no-nonsense mentality who enjoys actively participating in innovative bio-based processes.

You work independently, methodically, and accurately, and you have knowledge of biotechnological processes such as fermentation or biocatalysis, or experience in process industry, chemistry, or food. Experience with bio-based products and processes is a plus. You are a real team player and communicate fluently in both Dutch and English.

The ideal candidate holds a bachelor’s degree in chemistry, biochemistry, HBO5 chemistry/biochemistry, or a laboratory technician diploma. In this case, previous work experience is not required. If you already have experience in the process industry, chemistry, or food sector, an A2 diploma (secondary education) in a scientific or technical field is also sufficient.

Nobody is perfect, at Bio Base Europe Pilot Plant, there is plenty of room to learn by doing! Can’t check every box above, but are you flexible, eager to learn, and open to tailored training? Do you enjoy taking on challenges, with a healthy dose of pioneer spirit running through your veins? Then don’t hesitate to get in touch!

Production Operator with Technical Insight Wanted in Kampenhout!

Do you have experience in a production environment and enjoy taking responsibility?

This company, located in Kampenhout, is a leading producer and supplier of professional fluids for the automotive and industrial sectors.

From this site, they manufacture a wide range of maintenance, cleaning, and consumable products for workshops and garages.

To strengthen their team, they are looking for a Production Operator with technical insight who enjoys working independently and taking responsibility for an entire production line.

Your Challenge

As a Production Operator, you will be responsible for correctly setting up, converting, starting, and operating the production line.

You will ensure that every product is manufactured and filled according to the required specifications.

Your Responsibilities

Production Line Changeovers

• Adjusting and converting the production line according to technical specifications.
• Changing packaging materials, caps, labels, and boxes.
• Setting up printing information on bottles, cans, and boxes.
• Selecting the correct production programs and parameters.
• Starting up the production line.

Filling and Production

• Interpreting and following technical specifications and work instructions.
• Checking materials at the production line.
• Replenishing labels, packaging materials, and other production supplies.
• Manually packing finished products into boxes.
• Performing quality checks on weight, dosage, and product finish.
• Adjusting and fine-tuning machine settings when necessary.
• Monitoring the supply and flow of liquids throughout the process.
• Connecting new tanks to the production system.

Technical Follow-Up

• Detecting malfunctions and assisting in resolving them together with the technician.
• Reporting accurately to the Production Manager.
• Ensuring quality, safety, and efficiency throughout the production process.

REF:MEC1

• You have experience working on a production line.
• You work in a highly responsible and detail-oriented manner, with a strong focus on quality and safety.
• You are organized and tidy; you remove production waste and clean your workstation before handing it over to colleagues on the next shift.
• You are hands-on and capable of lifting and handling heavy objects with ease.
• You are eager to learn and support your colleagues; a technical background or education in mechanics or electrical/electronics engineering is a strong advantage, whether completed or not.
• You are dynamic and able to perform well under pressure.
• You are flexible and willing to work in different shifts (6:00 AM – 2:00 PM / 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM) and/or in the day shift (8:00 AM – 4:00 PM), depending on production needs. The same flexibility applies to overtime.
• You are fluent in Dutch, French, or English.
